purpose: Claims Manager prepares an approved claim settlement, verifies real payee details and explicitly authorises Finance to record external payment.
prerequisites: Live owning-service state and required record identifiers
business_rules: ClaimsManager stays with the claims specialist. ClaimsAdjuster prepares the file; decisions, authorization, payment, reconciliation and closure follow the backend workflow and delegated authority. Eligibility, payee verification and settlement authorization must not be skipped. An Admin is not a substitute for the backend claims approver.
A skill never adds permissions or simulates success.
Never register a replacement claim to correct an event date or bypass eligibility; preserve the original claim and require review with supporting evidence.
approvals: permission.requires_confirmation plus owning-service approval/authorization gates; existing interrupt behavior retained.
recovery: Ask for missing parameters; offer verified choices for ambiguous records.
Preserve completed steps; verify unknown mutation outcomes before retry.
Explain unsupported operations and route to the appropriate workspace or authorized staff.
verification: Report completion only from confirmed backend success. Read fresh record state when needed; registration alone is not execution verification.
unsupported: Inventing identity verification or bank details
Re-approving or replacing a claim to prepare settlement
